bug_semantics: An authenticated Administration Console user can submit attacker-controlled text in a persistent configuration attribute, demonstrated by the Deploy Application description field at POST /common/applications/uploadFrame.jsf (form:war:psection:descriptionProp:description). A later browser request to /management/domain/applications/application/ negotiates GlassFish's text/html management representation. The HTML provider reads the stored ConfigBean attribute and concatenates it into generated markup without HTML/attribute encoding; the reported payload begins with a double quote and contains , breaking out of the generated value attribute and creating an executable element. JavaScript then runs in the Administration Console origin and can read information or issue requests with the victim administrator's session.
flaw_origin: The smallest source commit is legacy GlassFish Git commit be6b1571814721625e5e70343a2b178076d61450 (SVN revision 26425), which first added the REST management module and v3/admin/rest/src/main/java/org/glassfish/admin/rest/provider/SingletonDomHtmlProvider.java. Its getAttributes(Dom) directly appended proxy.attribute(attribute) between HTML tags with no output encoding. Commit 881906985072f3326ed2a53d3aa2f07a2c0973f8 later moved the same unsafe value into an input value attribute, and subsequent module moves, renames, formatting, and Eclipse's 2018 Initial Contribution preserved the flaw; those are not BICs. The current descendant is nucleus/admin/rest/rest-service/src/main/java/org/glassfish/admin/rest/provider/ProviderUtil.java, where getHtmlRepresentationForAttributes passes proxy.attribute(xmlAttributeName) to getHtmlRespresentationForParameter and that method still appends parameterValue directly into value="...".
ai_marker: BIC commit object has author and committer Ludovic Champenois <ludo@java.net>, both dated 2009-04-20T18:37:17Z. Its message begins 'First pass at RESTFul based access to the GlassFish ServerBeans' and ends with SVN metadata ('svn path=/trunk/; revision=26425' and 'Former-commit-id: 35811e...'). The complete commit object has no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI-assistant trailer, AI/bot identity, or other AI attribution marker.
evidence: First-party report https://gitlab.eclipse.org/security/vulnerability-reports/-/work_items/230 specifies authenticated access, uploadFrame.jsf, parameter form:war:psection:descriptionProp:description, a payload beginning with a double quote and containing , the later /management/domain/applications/application/xss-stored request, and session-context impact. In the validated clone, reproduce the BIC with: git log -S 'proxy.attribute(attribute)' be6b1571814721625e5e70343a2b178076d61450 -- v3/admin/rest/src/main/java/org/glassfish/admin/rest/provider/SingletonDomHtmlProvider.java; it returns only be6b1571814721625e5e70343a2b178076d61450. Then run git log -L 119,130:v3/admin/rest/src/main/java/org/glassfish/admin/rest/provider/SingletonDomHtmlProvider.java be6b1571814721625e5e70343a2b178076d61450; the /dev/null addition directly concatenates attribute, a colon, and proxy.attribute(attribute) between h2 tags. Direct parent check: git ls-tree -r --name-only ca915d3d98df6c4091499968f9b64eb3f8af9783 -- that path prints nothing, while git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-status -r be6b1571814721625e5e70343a2b178076d61450 -- that path prints 'A'. Inspect the BIC object with git cat-file -p be6b1571814721625e5e70343a2b178076d61450 or https://api.github.com/repos/javaee/glassfish/git/commits/be6b1571814721625e5e70343a2b178076d61450 for its human identity, complete message, and parent. Version boundary: tag 7.0.15 resolves to 6f2f4c26b0f825d36b45ef39f6f83ac6b56d438c; tag 7.0.25 resolves to 17c9f164606e47efbc58907a97ad351a7f54089e; the advisory range is <=7.0.25 with no first patched version. git grep -n 'append(parameterValue)' 7.0.15, 7.0.25, 7.0.26, and HEAD against nucleus/admin/rest/rest-service/src/main/java/org/glassfish/admin/rest/provider/ProviderUtil.java finds the raw value-attribute sink in every revision. Tag 7.0.26 resolves to 215b00392179abfef69725ff07455096f2e7fa19, and audited HEAD 4a143866f4a92995e6387ee33f5412bdeac38567 (2026-08-27) retains it. The file's complete reachable history after 2018 has no encoding fix, and neither the management nor Administration Console trees contain Content-Security-Policy or X-Content-Type-Options compensation. Therefore the case remains explicitly unpatched and no fix commit exists to record.
reasoning: The vulnerability is caused by an HTML response generator, not by the upload form itself: storage merely supplies the tainted configuration value, while the browser-facing management provider converts that value to active markup without contextual encoding. The original 2009 REST commit already created this behavior; the 2009 form rewrite, 2011/2017 moves, 2018 repository import, and later cleanup commits only preserved or relocated it. Both -S and -L identify be6b1571814721625e5e70343a2b178076d61450, and its immediate parent lacks the provider entirely. Because the BIC commit object identifies a human author/committer and contains no AI attribution or bot marker, the BIC-only rule yields NOT_AI. The null fix fields are intentional: this is an unpatched case, corroborated by the advisory's absent patched version and persistence of the sink through 7.0.26 and current HEAD.
remaining_gap: Unpatched as of audited HEAD 4a143866f4a92995e6387ee33f5412bdeac38567 (2026-08-27); no upstream closing fix or first patched version exists, so fix_sha and direct_fix_sha are null rather than unknown.
